name: earlybird-stewardship
title: EarlyBird Stewardship
description: The EarlyBird stewardship MCP service and the Omnigraph server that holds the EarlyBird knowledge graph, in one app. The Bots connect to the service over MCP, each with its own credential (a bearer token, or an OAuth grant the owner approves); the owner's console under /console/ is behind Hola's sign-in; the graph server is reachable only by the service. After install the service starts with no graph and is not ready: it serves no Bot until the owner has set the graph up in the console (upload of the graph schema file, preview, apply), added the Bots and issued a first credential there (see the compose file). The owner can then migrate the corpus into the graph from the console and, once the cutover is directed and the owner has created a bucket, a signing key and a publishing credential outside Hola, publish releases to that bucket; publishing is off until those settings are given.

defaultEnv.label: Graph Admin Token
defaultEnv.description: Bearer token of the graph server's `hola-admin` actor. It can change the graph's configuration and every record. Used only by the operator on the host; never give it to a Bot and never put it in a connector.

defaultEnv.label: Graph Console Token
defaultEnv.description: Bearer token of the graph server's `earlybird-console` actor. It can change the graph's policy and delete a graph. Only the stewardship service holds it, and uses it only for the owner's changes in the console (setup, domains, roster). It must differ from the runtime token. Never give it to a Bot and never put it in a connector or a browser.

defaultEnv.label: Graph Runtime Token
defaultEnv.description: Bearer token of the graph server's `earlybird-runtime` actor. Only the stewardship service holds it. Never give it to a Bot.

defaultEnv.label: Graph Release Token
defaultEnv.description: Bearer token of the graph server's `earlybird-release` actor (the operator's import and publish commands). Never give it to a Bot.

defaultEnv.label: Lease Key
defaultEnv.description: Derives the lease tokens the service hands to a Bot that claims work. Keep it stable across redeploys: changing it invalidates every open lease.

defaultEnv.label: Console Identity Secret
defaultEnv.description: Hola sends it as the X-Hola-Identity-Secret header on the sign-in-gated route only, and the owner's console accepts the sign-in's identity headers only together with it. Without it the console is off. Never give it to a Bot and never put it in a connector.

defaultEnv.label: Console Owner Groups
defaultEnv.description: Comma-separated sign-in (Authentik) groups whose members are owners in the console. Use a group this app's sign-in gate admits (the manifest's allowedGroups, `hola-admins`). With this and the owner usernames both empty, every console request is refused.

defaultEnv.label: Console Owner Usernames (optional)
defaultEnv.description: Comma-separated sign-in (Authentik) usernames that are owners in the console, in addition to the owner groups. A username listed here must still be admitted by the sign-in gate's group.

defaultEnv.label: Ready Check Interval (seconds)
defaultEnv.description: How often the service checks the graph while it is not ready (no graph yet, or a definition it does not support). A whole number from 1 to 3600.

defaultEnv.label: Release Bucket (optional)
defaultEnv.description: Release publishing (off unless every one of the six settings without a default is set; leave all nine empty until the owner has created the bucket, the signing key and the publishing credential, askearlybird/earlybird-app#1959, and directs the cutover). Name of the bucket that receives immutable corpus releases. Set together with the five other required release settings, or leave all empty.

defaultEnv.label: Release Region (optional)
defaultEnv.description: The region of the release bucket and of the signing key. Required for publishing.

defaultEnv.label: Release Key Prefix (optional)
defaultEnv.description: Empty, or a relative key prefix ending in `/`. Optional even when publishing is configured.

defaultEnv.label: Release Signing Key Id (optional)
defaultEnv.description: ARN or identifier of the key that signs a release's digest. Required for publishing.

defaultEnv.label: Release Signing Public Key (optional)
defaultEnv.description: The signing key's public half, P-256, in PEM form. It is public, not a secret. Required for publishing. The wizard has no multi-line field: how a PEM block with its line breaks is entered here was not checked.

defaultEnv.label: Release Publishing Access Key Id (optional)
defaultEnv.description: Identifier of the publishing credential: may add an object under the bucket's prefix only when the key is absent, and ask the one key to sign a digest. Treated as a secret here although it identifies rather than authorizes. Required for publishing.

defaultEnv.label: Release Publishing Secret Access Key (optional)
defaultEnv.description: Secret of the publishing credential. Supplied by the owner (an AWS secret cannot be generated by Hola); at least 16 characters and different from every other secret of this app. Never give it to a Bot. Required for publishing.

defaultEnv.label: Release Storage Endpoint (stand-in only)
defaultEnv.description: For stand-ins on 127.0.0.1 only. Leave empty on Hola.

defaultEnv.label: Release Signing Endpoint (stand-in only)
defaultEnv.description: For stand-ins on 127.0.0.1 only. Leave empty on Hola.

defaultEnv.label: Log Level
defaultEnv.description: debug, info, warn or error. Request bodies are never logged.
